title: Writing --- My Own Line
label: ch:ar-satri-al-khass
canDo: I can write one line of Arabic about myself from a closed supply of known words, choosing not only the words but the shape each letter takes where it stands.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-W02-satri-al-khass: one line chosen rather than copied, with the joins checked before anything else.
payoff.note: The first writing step with nothing to reach for. Copying hid the shape decision: an Arabic letter has up to four forms and the model always showed the right one, so choosing your own words means choosing the shapes too.
